correctness.rationale: The split-epimorphism and formal inverse argument establish |U_N|=q^D. For any involution with linear part A, h=(id+A^{-1}f)/2 is an invertible identity-tangent substitution and satisfies hf=Ah; the U_N orbit has size |U_N|/|C_U_N(A)|. Coefficientwise parity gives dimensions D-E for A=-I and D/2 for the mixed A; the GL2 mixed conjugacy class has q(q+1) elements. Exhaustive quadratic q=3,5 and independent cubic extension q=3 computations corroborate. Odd/even exponent arithmetic is explicit.
